_note: First combat campaign — scripted encounters vs Adversary decks. Deck lists are padded/cycled to 30 by the loader; unknown ids are dropped. enemyBoard units are pre-placed (summoning-sick turn 1).

prologue.title: First Lesson
prologue.subtitle: Raiders at the edge of the camp
prologue.narrative: Before any giant, a handful of raiders. Every story in this book starts somewhere small.
prologue.tip: Drag a card onto your side of the board to play it. Drag a ready unit onto an enemy, or onto their hero, to attack. Press End Turn when you're done. Bring their hero to 0.

encounters.title: The Valley of Elah
encounters.subtitle: David & Goliath
encounters.narrative: Forty days the giant of Gath taunted the armies of Israel, and not one soldier would face him. Then a shepherd boy arrived with a sling and five smooth stones.  — 1 Samuel 17
encounters.tip: You start at 23 health. Goliath never swings — he taunts — but while he stands, his Guard shields the whole Philistine line and their hero. Topple him: Shepherd David is a Giant-Slayer (he destroys any 4+ attack unit he strikes and takes no counter-damage), and slaying a giant makes him David the King. The rival plays at Sage.

encounters.title: Bricks Without Straw
encounters.subtitle: The Taskmasters of Egypt
encounters.narrative: Make the same quota of bricks — but gather your own straw. Pharaoh's overseers pressed harder, and the people groaned under the whip.  — Exodus 5
encounters.tip: You start worn down — 21 health. The Taskmaster weakens your units on arrival; trade efficiently, keep tempo, and let Endure and Guard bodies buy you time. The rival plays at Sage.

encounters.title: The Serpent's Question
encounters.subtitle: Did God really say...?
encounters.narrative: The subtlest of all the creatures asked a question that wasn't really a question. Doubt is a slow poison, and the garden was very quiet.  — Genesis 3
encounters.tip: A Genesis war-band under Abraham, at 22 health. The Serpent and Delilah strip your units of their text and keywords — don't over-invest in one build-around; let the Covenant compound on a wide board. The rival plays at Sage.

encounters.title: The Fiery Furnace
encounters.subtitle: Nebuchadnezzar's Decree
encounters.narrative: Bow to the golden image or burn. Three men would not bow, so the furnace was heated seven times hotter. Yet the king rose in alarm — for a fourth walked with them in the fire, and not a hair was singed.  — Daniel 3
encounters.tip: Nebuchadnezzar sits enthroned — a 7/9 who never takes the field himself, and no Guard, so you can strike past him. His host is the danger: the Assyrians, Haman, the chariots. Read the deck with Foresee and burn what matters. The rival plays at Sage.
